steps.instruction: Place the 220Ω resistor from +5V rail to hole E5

hints.missing: Insert the 220Ω resistor between +5V and E5.

steps.instruction: Insert LED: long leg (anode) in E5, short leg (cathode) in E6

hints.missing: Insert the LED with the longer leg in E5.
hints.wrong_position: Move the LED cathode to row E6.

steps.instruction: Connect jumper wire from hole E6 to GND rail (-)

hints.missing: Add a wire connecting E6 to the ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: Move the wire to connect E6 to ground.

steps.instruction: Connect 5V power supply to the + and - rails

hints.missing: Connect your power leads to activate the circuit.
hints.safety_violation: Power rail bridged directly to ground! Remove bridge immediately.
